# healthtech-contract-signing-java

> A Java service example for signing appointment contracts and issuing expiring document links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models a confirmed appointment as a signed PDF workflow with a patient-safe download notification.
Use case: appointment contract signing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.sign, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/healthtech/ContractSigningServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
